posts.cooked:
Granted I don't know who is who, but most extras featured in both Rook City and Infernal Relics is based on fans. Such as all underbosses and thugs from the Chairman's deck is someone. Any person in Spite's deck that isn't Spite or a hero, though Collateral Damage is a maybe. I don't think Plague Rat and Matriarch feature anyone. GloomWeaver's Cultist and even Vast Following feature real life folks. Apostate homes one of them aswell in... I don't feel like digging out the cards right now, but it is the one where the guy is being impaled in the chest by Apostate and Fanatic is flying towards them. I can't recall any other ones at the moment, like I said much too lazy to open it up and dig into the cards.

Shattered Timelines i'm not so sure about, as it didn't offer it as a reward tier in the kickstarter.
